Survey title: Enquête nutritionnelle nationale selon la méthodologie SMART/SENS, Niger 2025 (rapport final)
Lead organization: Institut National de la Statistique (INS) / Direction de la Nutrition (with UNICEF, UNHCR, WFP, WHO, FAO)
Geographic coverage: National, 8 regions; 9 departments of Maradi (separate samples); 11 refugee and asylum-seeker strata (4 planned sites, 7 unplanned sites / host villages) in Agadez, Diffa, Maradi, Tahoua, Tillabéri
Notes: Final report dated October 2025. Data collection: national 1-25 Sept 2025; Maradi departments 19 Sept-13 Oct 2025; refugees 19 Sept-19 Oct 2025 (row dates follow this). Maradi region (Admin 1) values come from the national sample; the 9 departments are a separate sample, not weighted into the region. Refugee anthropometry covers 6-59 months. Refugee summary Tableau 24 is misaligned for unplanned sites (stunting/underweight shifted by one row): detailed Tableaux 40 and 46 used. Morbidity combined column ('IRA + Fièvre + Diarrhée') is unreliable for Maradi departments (Tableau 65) and copies the Fever column for refugees (Tableau 66). Tableau 55 title mentions refugees but refugee mortality is in Tableau 56.
